run_fillerbuster_training: run the fillerbuster training pipeline on a dataset using ns-train with method and dataset settings
run_render_trajectory: render a circle or custom camera path trajectory video from a trained fillerbuster config
run_render_dataset: render all training dataset images from a trained fillerbuster model config
run_dry_run_commands: preview all training and rendering commands without executing them using the dry-run flag
run_calibrated_scene_completion: run the full calibrated scene completion experiment pipeline with train, render, and dataset modes
